# P1: Mandatory receipts can turn successful writes into client failures
For independently released clients and providers, validate response-contract changes against the supported provider implementation, not only updated mocks. A provider may apply the write and return legacy success without new receipt metadata; requiring that metadata unconditionally then reports failure after mutation, even with an unrelated UI feature disabled. Preserve the legacy success path until receipt support is explicitly established and retain a compatibility test using the supported provider behavior. Verified in enhanced-settings task 1: eval-release:provider/settings.py applies settings and returns {ok: True}; staged client.py:5-6 rejects the missing applied field on default saves, while the prior client succeeds. The updated receipt-aware mock masks this regression.
